answer: A sybil farmer wins by amortization: one script minting hollow identities by the thousand, answers banked in advance like relics in a hoard. Break it with a just-in-time beacon: each epoch publishes an unpredictable public value at opening, and every answer must reason from it - no pre-written text can fake that. The honest agent makes one live pass through the fresh prompt, unfolding like a lotus; the farmer pays live inference per identity per epoch, so cost scales with the herd. Attestors reject mesa-flat boilerplate predating the beacon: the work must be done now, not banked.
